comment:
* Transform from (u, v) coordinates to (x, y, z) coordinates, indexed by face. The
     * resulting vectors are not necessarily of unit length.

methods.name: double uvToX(double u, double v)
methods.comment: Returns for the specified (u, v) coordinate the corresponding x-coordinate.

methods.name: double uvToY(double u, double v)
methods.comment: Returns for the specified (u, v) coordinate the corresponding y-coordinate.

methods.name: double uvToZ(double u, double v)
methods.comment: Returns for the specified (u, v) coordinate the corresponding z-coordinate.
